question: Could you generate a report that shows the number of delivered orders for each month in the years 2016, 2017, and 2018? Each column represents a year, and each row represents a month
sql:
WITH monthly_delivered AS (
  SELECT 
    CAST(strftime('%m', CAST(order_delivered_customer_date AS TIMESTAMP)) AS INTEGER) AS month,
    CAST(strftime('%Y', CAST(order_delivered_customer_date AS TIMESTAMP)) AS INTEGER) AS year,
    COUNT(*) AS cnt
  FROM olist_orders
  WHERE order_status = 'delivered'
    AND order_delivered_customer_date IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY year, month
),
all_months AS (
  SELECT 1 AS month UNION ALL SELECT 2 UNION ALL SELECT 3 UNION ALL SELECT 4
  UNION ALL SELECT 5 UNION ALL SELECT 6 UNION ALL SELECT 7 UNION ALL SELECT 8
  UNION ALL SELECT 9 UNION ALL SELECT 10 UNION ALL SELECT 11 UNION ALL SELECT 12
)
SELECT 
  am.month,
  COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN md.year = 2016 THEN md.cnt END), 0)::INTEGER AS delivered_2016,
  COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN md.year = 2017 THEN md.cnt END), 0)::INTEGER AS delivered_2017,
  COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN md.year = 2018 THEN md.cnt END), 0)::INTEGER AS delivered_2018
FROM all_months am
LEFT JOIN monthly_delivered md ON am.month = md.month
GROUP BY am.month
ORDER BY am.month
